But we might need to check fuel level? There's no function to get current fuel level. But estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage probably uses internal state. So call that with distance=380. Then if not feasible, fillFuelTank with maximum? It says fillFuelTank takes fuelAmount. We want to fill completely. Fuel tank holds up to 50 gallons. But we don't know current fuel. We can just fill 50 gallons? But maybe we should fill to capacity. We can call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount=50. That will fill 50 gallons. But if already partially filled, it might overfill? But spec says "The amount of fuel to fill in gallons; this is the additional fuel to add to the tank." So we can fill 50 gallons. That might exceed capacity but tool may handle. Alternatively we could call find_nearest_tire_shop? No.

So steps: call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance=380. Then if result indicates not feasible, call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount=50. Then maybe display log. We'll do that.
